findings.issue: Misquotes the sentence as どんな長い日にも (drops the に of どんなに) and claims the pattern is どんな + N + にも; the sentence actually uses the adverb どんなに modifying 長い (どんなに + adj + N + にも), as the token list itself shows.
findings.current: The pattern is どんな + N + にも = 'even for any N (no matter which)'. Here どんな長い日にも = 'even on the longest of days'.
findings.suggested: Pattern どんなに + adjective + N + にも: どんなに長い日にも = 'even on a day, however long it may be'. にも = に (on/for) + も (even), concessive.

findings.issue: Same error as expl_en: cita a frase errada como どんな長い日にも (sem o に de どんなに) and teaches the pattern as どんな + N + にも, but the sentence uses the adverb どんなに modifying 長い.
findings.current: O padrão é どんな + N + にも = 'mesmo para qualquer N (não importa qual)'. Aqui どんな長い日にも = 'mesmo no mais longo dos dias'.
findings.suggested: O padrão é どんなに + adjetivo + N + にも: どんなに長い日にも = 'mesmo num dia, por mais longo que seja'. にも = に (em) + も (até), valor concessivo.

findings.issue: どんな here is the stem of the adverb どんなに (the following に token is dissected separately), a degree adverb modifying 長い — not an adnominal modifying 日. The role contradicts the に token's own note (どんなに as inflected form).
findings.current: adnominal concessivo (modifica 日 junto com 長い)
findings.suggested: parte do advérbio de grau どんなに (com に; modifica 長い)

findings.issue: Misquotes the sentence as どんな長い日でも (drops the に of どんなに) and identifies the pattern as どんな + N + でも; the sentence uses the adverb どんなに modifying 長い (どんなに + adj + N + でも).
findings.current: Same concessive base どんな + N + でも = 'even any N'. Here どんな長い日でも = 'even on the longest of days'.
findings.suggested: Concessive base どんなに + adjective + N + でも: どんなに長い日でも = 'even a day, however long'. でも (copula で + も) reinforces 'no matter which'.

findings.issue: Same error as expl_en: quotes the sentence as どんな長い日でも (missing the に of どんなに) and teaches どんな + N + でも, but the sentence uses adverbial どんなに modifying 長い.
findings.current: Mesma base concessiva どんな + N + でも = 'mesmo qualquer N'. Aqui どんな長い日でも = 'mesmo no mais longo dos dias'.
findings.suggested: Base concessiva どんなに + adjetivo + N + でも: どんなに長い日でも = 'mesmo um dia, por mais longo que seja'. でも (で da cópula + も) reforça 'não importa qual'.

findings.issue: どんな is the stem of the adverb どんなに (the に token is dissected right after it), modifying 長い as a degree adverb — not an adnominal modifying 日.
findings.current: adnominal concessivo (modifica 日 junto com 長い)
findings.suggested: parte do advérbio de grau どんなに (com に; modifica 長い)

findings.issue: 遅く is the adverbial form of 遅い ('late'); the EN gloss 'afternoon' is a different word entirely (back-translation artifact of pt 'tarde') and teaches a false meaning. The pt gloss and the note are correct.
'O quanto que (eu) o elogie' is not grammatical pt-BR and loses the concessive force of ても that lit_en renders as 'No matter how much'.
findings.current: O quanto que (eu) o elogie, não consigo elogiar até o fim.
findings.suggested: Não importa o quanto (eu) o elogie, não consigo elogiar até o fim.

findings.issue: 'Mesmo que tipo de cama' is broken Portuguese: 'mesmo que' parses as the conjunction 'even if' followed by an interrogative fragment. どんな…でも = 'qualquer ... que seja'; lit_en correctly uses 'any kind'.
findings.current: Mesmo que tipo de cama, é melhor do que não haver (cama).
findings.suggested: Mesmo qualquer tipo de cama, é melhor do que não haver (cama).
